err.no_tv: No TV was found on the network. Is it on and connected to the same network as this PC?
err.tv_offline: {name} is not on the network – turn it on.
err.wake_failed: {name} didn't turn on over the network. Turn it on with the remote, or enable turning on over the network in its settings (LG: Turn on via Wi-Fi/LAN, Samsung: Power on with mobile / IP Remote). Some TVs can't do this over Wi-Fi.
err.firewall: The TV couldn't connect to this PC – Windows Firewall is probably blocking it. Allow the app to accept incoming connections on private networks.
err.format: The TV can't play this video format{detail}.
err.no_ffmpeg: {name} is missing – install ffmpeg (winget install Gyan.FFmpeg).
warn.image_subs: The subtitles in this video are image-based (Blu-ray/DVD) and the TV won't show them over the network – save “{name}” next to the video.
err.video_codec: {name} can't play {codec} video, only {codecs}. The picture would have to be re-encoded.
warn.dv5: This video is Dolby Vision profile 5 and this TV doesn't support Dolby Vision – the colours will probably be wrong (green and purple).
warn.stalled: {name} reports that it's playing, but the video isn't moving. Is the player open on the TV screen?
warn.kodi_background: {name} reports that it's playing, but the video isn't moving. Kodi must be open on the TV screen – when it's only running in the background, it won't play the video.
err.firewall_cancelled: Allowing the app in the firewall was cancelled.
power.reason: {app} is playing video on a TV
ui.noTvHint: Turn on a TV on the same network
ui.offOrAway: Off or not on the network
ui.searchingPlayers: Looking for players on the network…
ui.noDevicesFound: No TV found on the network. Is it on and connected to the same network?
ui.startInQueue: Start a video from the queue
ui.preparingPct: Preparing the video for the TV… {pct}
ui.dropOverlay: Drop the videos to add them to the queue
ui.optSendToSub: An item in the File Explorer right-click menu
ui.optHdAudio: Convert TrueHD and DTS to Dolby Digital
ui.optHdAudioSub: Most TVs can't play TrueHD or DTS over the network (picture yes, sound no). Turn off if your TV or player (e.g. Kodi) supports them – Dolby Atmos in TrueHD is then kept too.
ui.optDvMp4Sub: Some TVs (e.g. LG) turn on Dolby Vision only from MP4 and play just HDR10 from MKV. Repacking a 4K film takes tens of seconds – turn off if your TV plays Dolby Vision from MKV or doesn't support it.
ui.optWolSub: A “Try to turn on” button for switched-off TVs (Wake-on-LAN). The TV must allow turning on over the network – LG: Turn on via Wi-Fi/LAN, Samsung: Power on with mobile / IP Remote. Some TVs can't do this over Wi-Fi.
ui.optLangsSub: Order for choosing audio and subtitles, e.g. en, de, fr. Empty = by app language
ui.optFirewallSub: If the TV can't load the video – allows incoming connections from your home network
ui.imageSubsWarn: These subtitles are image-based (Blu-ray/DVD) and the TV won't show them over the network. Save a “{name}” file next to the video.
